content: Cameras & Lenses: Nikon D3200 DSLR (reliable workhorse), Yongnuo 50mm f/1.8 prime lens, kit lenses; interest/access to Sony ZV-E10, Canon M50, and GoPro.
Camera Support: DJI Ronin-SC 3-axis gimbal stabilizer, sturdy tripods, high-speed SD cards, and external storage drives.
Engineering Station: Windows 11 workstation running VS Code, PowerShell, Node.js, Rust toolchain, Cursor/Antigravity, and Tauri v2 dev environment.
Running Gear: Cushioned road daily trainers, trail shoes, GPS running watch, running belt, and anti-chafe gear.
